title: Concatenation of Array
summary: Make a new array by writing every value of nums in order, then writing that same sequence a second time.
statement: Make a new array by writing every value of nums in order, then writing that same sequence a second time.

examples.explanation: The second half starts again at 5.
Repeated values retain both copies in each half.

hints: Conceptual: Both copies have the same order.
Directional: Allocate twice the original length.
Implementation: Copy index i into positions i and i+n.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(n) space for the output.
